sources: https://epoch.ai/MirrorCode (Epoch AI + METR, paper PDF hash _8ae911f, 2026-06)
_meta.notes: MirrorCode = reimplement-CLI-from-black-box-behavior benchmark. 25 targets (10 S/11 M/4 L) × 6 languages (Python/C/Rust/Go/OCaml/Ada) = 132 task instances. Up to 10B tokens/L-task (~$5k). Hidden tests (~34%) + separate-sandbox scoring + no internet + memorization screen. Opus 4.7 56%/77% rank 1, GPT-5.5 44/57, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (Python-only) 32/44. Mythos/Opus 4.8/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi NOT evaluated yet. Excluded: GPT-5 27% (extrapolation, not measured); Opus 4.1/4.6 (Figure 10 subset, not directly comparable). NVFP4 = NVIDIA PTQ via nvidia-modelopt v0.46.0, MoE expert linears only, calibration set undisclosed. Accuracy table reports vs FP8 baseline (zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8), not vs BF16/FP16 — at-parity or slightly better on all 5 benches (avg ratio 100.27%).

benchmarks.name: MirrorCode solve@100%
benchmarks.description: Reimplement entire CLI program end-to-end from black-box behavior alone — no source-code access, no internet, byte-exact stdout/stderr match against visible + held-out tests. 25 targets (10 Small + 11 Medium + 4 Large incl 3 private S/M/L) × 6 languages (Python/C/Rust/Go/OCaml/Ada) = 132 instances. Up to 10B tokens per Large task (~$5k). Hidden tests ~34% + separate-sandbox scoring + memorization screen. Per-target mean of share-of-attempts passing 100% of tests.

benchmarks.name: MirrorCode solve@≥99%
benchmarks.description: Relaxed threshold — per-target mean of share-of-attempts passing ≥99% of tests. Secondary metric.
